summary: Stabilis Solutions filed an 8-K (Items 1.02, 9.01) disclosing the termination of a time charter agreement between its subsidiary Stabilis GDS and Seaspan Energy Ltd. for the LNG bunkering vessel Seaspan Garibaldi. The Owners exercised a termination option on June 24, 2026, effective that day, under a Termination Option Agreement dated June 11, 2026. Stabilis GDS must pay a $750,000 early termination fee due January 1, 2027, plus ~$1.1 million in accrued amounts payable in Q3 2026. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for potential liquidity impact or alternative vessel arrangements; no risk-arb angle as this is a contract termination, not a merger.
